svg.title: Red Corona: Catching secrets from space — Berry Punch stream announcement
svg.desc: Original USAF photograph of a C-119J Flying Boxcar of the 6593d with its recovery gear extended during a training parachute recovery in 1959. Photo from PDF page 36, printed page 25, of CORONA Star Catchers. Watch the visual stream at https://kick.com/berry-punch.
svg.metadata: New adaptation of Uniflora nocturnal-optics; source https://github.com/sporemound/uniflora-aesthetic-kit at commit 92acf469da1a832c0bad510472dd2a31a832acd8. Credit: Uniflora contributors. Reference documentation and original motifs: CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Code scope: Unlicense. USAF photograph reproduced from the user-provided CORONA Star Catchers, NRO, June 2012, PDF page 36, printed page 25. Photo geometry preserved. Changes: original poster layout and editable lettering for Berry Punch, using a real archival photo instead of generated artwork. No kit motif or font file redistributed.
svg.text: TIM GLISTER'S THRILLER · THE REAL CORONA PROGRAMME
